Hardware Electronics Engineer Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience) Type Full-Time, On-Site Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus About Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular IoT modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — quectel.com Our history & global footprint — quectel.com/company/history LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric LatAm customer story (Brazil) Follow us on LinkedIn The Role We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial IoT, connected payments, and more. Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market. "Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay." What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2G/3G/4G/5G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed IoT company behind you. Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: | Browse open roles: quectel.com/recruitment Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

Participar de Licitações, quando necessário. Buscamos alguém que apresente: Formação Superior Completa em Biomedicina, Farmácia ou Ciências Biológicas; Experiência na área comercial; CNH - B (habilidade na direção- será realizado teste de habilidade); Experiência com elaboração de propostas comerciais/financeiras, domínio do pacote office, excel intermediário ou avançado, análise e interpretação de indicadores; Disponibilidade para viagens semanais. Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que: • Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times; • Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas; • Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo; • Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas; • Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade; • Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado. Informações sobre a vaga: Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial. Local: Manaus - AM. Horário de Trabalho: 08h as 18h segunda à sexta feira. Disponibilidade para viagens semanais. Oferecemos remuneração fixa + bonificações. Carro da empresa e ajuda de custo. Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada! Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família; Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina; Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras; Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional; Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas; Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida. Proteção e estabilidade: Previdência privada; Participação nos lucros; Seguro de vida. Facilidades para o dia a dia: Vale-Alimentação; Vale-Refeição; Vale-Transporte; Auxílio-Creche; Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços. Desenvolvimento e educação: Plataforma de ensino; Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições. Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória. Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas. Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família. Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site: O Grupo Fleury informa que a participação em seus processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhuma empresa terceira está autorizada a cobrar valores para a candidatura às vagas, ao treinamento, ao material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

vagas.title: Hardware engineer
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Hardware engineer em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Hardware Electronics Engineer Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience) Type Full-Time, On-Site Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus About Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular Io T modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — Our history & global footprint — LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial Io T, connected payments, and more. Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market. "Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay." What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5 G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company's foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our Saa S ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, Java Script). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate Saa S contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based Saa S ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. About the Role Job Title: Annotation & Review Specialist Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based Location: Remote (Work From Home) Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day Eligibility: Open to candidates with a High school or above degree Language Required : Polish We are seeking for detail-oriented and quality-focused individuals to join our team as Annotation & Review Specialists. This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours. The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy. Key Responsibilities: Perform annotation tasks on images and videos as per project guidelines. Review annotated images and video content to ensure accuracy and quality standards are met. Provide clear and constructive feedback on annotations and identify areas requiring correction or improvement. Follow project instructions, workflows, and timelines consistently. Required Skills & Qualifications High school or Bachelor's degree in mandatory. Ability to understand and follow detailed annotation guidelines. Note: For this role, you are required to complete the Internal assessment and English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

Nosso propósito é ajudar a impulsionar esses negócios permitindo que sejam cada vez mais fortes e tenham mais chances de prosperar. Por aqui, ajudamos pessoas a encontrarem e se conectarem a lugares incríveis para aumentar sua autoestima! Não faltarão desafios para colocarmos todos os salões do Brasil nos Trinks! Buscamos um Dev Ops Pleno para atuar no time de infraestrutura, com foco em automação, estabilidade e evolução contínua dos ambientes cloud. Você será responsável por manter e aprimorar pipelines de CI/CD, gerenciar a infraestrutura na AWS, acompanhar métricas de monitoramento, atuar na resolução de incidentes e liderar a comunicação técnica com times internos e parceiros. Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução: Garantir a confiabilidade e estabilidade dos ambientes produtivos e de homologação; Promover boas práticas de automação e infraestrutura como código (Ia C); Otimizar o ciclo de deploy e monitoramento contínuo; Conduzir comunicações técnicas com fornecedores e stakeholders; Inspirar confiança e ser referência técnica dentro do time. O que você precisa para o #match perfeito: Experiência sólida com AWS (ECS, EC2, RDS, ALB, WAF, Cloud Watch, S3); Conhecimento em Infra as Code (Terraform e/ou Cloud Formation); Experiência com pipelines CI/CD (Git Hub Actions ou similares); Conhecimento em monitoramento, logging e automação de alertas; Experiência com Docker e ambientes Linux e Windows Server; Conhecimento de redes, DNS, SSL, balanceamento e segurança em nuvem; Gostar de compartilhar conhecimentos e de trabalhar com equipe colaborativa. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Experiência com monitoramento avançado (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana); Conhecimento em scripts de automação (Python, Bash, Power Shell); Vivência com ECS Fargate e pipelines multiambiente; Experiência em otimização de custos em AWS; Certificações AWS ou Dev Ops. Saca só o que OFERECEMOS: 100% Home office; Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais); Auxílio home office; Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível; Plano de Saúde Sul América (custo zero para o colaborador); Plano Odonto Sul América (custo zero para o colaborador); Total Pass (plano academia); Incentivo ao Desenvolvimento: PDI, Capacitações, Feedbacks, Desconto com Faculdades e Cursos de Idiomas; Bônus por indicação de talentos; Day off de aniversário e tempo de casa. Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência. Na Trinks, valorizamos a melhor versão de você mesmo, com incentivos e autonomia para trabalhar, desenvolver e implementar ideias. E aí, se identificou? vagas.title: Senior machine learning engineer
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Senior machine learning engineer em rio branco. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us. What you'll do Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results. What we're looking for We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you. You'll be successful in this role if you have: Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow). Nice to have (not required) Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval. Why Join Us You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction. Equal Opportunity Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world's premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others. Position Summary: Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil. The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team. Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: These may include but are not limited to: Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned. Required Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action Travel: You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems. Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes. Requirements Minimum qualification: High School completed or pursuing Bachelors. Strong command of English (written and verbal). Excellent analytical and communication skills. Comfortable working with diverse content types. Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet. If you're detail-oriented, tech-curious, and eager to contribute to the future of AI, we'd love to have you in our growing network. If Interested, kindly send your resume at:. " Please note that the organization follows a strict no-fee recruitment policy and does not request any payment from candidates at any stage of the hiring process, including through third-party agencies or consultants. Candidates are advised to immediately report any such payment requests in connection with employment opportunities, as they are unauthorized and fraudulent."

vagas.title: Customer success manager
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Customer success manager em boa vista. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B) About Sisense Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (An Paa S) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action. The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance. Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense's growth in embedded AI analytics. About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning. Requirements 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions. How You'll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals. What We Offer Employment through a partner agency (B2 B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

vagas.title: Devops pl
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Devops pl em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

#Vem Pra Trinks Aqui você vai fazer parte de um #timaço que tem a missão de revolucionar o mercado da beleza através de soluções digitais completas para estabelecimentos do ramo, que vão desde a gestão do negócio até serviços financeiros, ferramentas de fidelização, agendamento online e muito mais! Nosso propósito é ajudar a impulsionar esses negócios permitindo que sejam cada vez mais fortes e tenham mais chances de prosperar. Por aqui, ajudamos pessoas a encontrarem e se conectarem a lugares incríveis para aumentar sua autoestima! Não faltarão desafios para colocarmos todos os salões do Brasil nos Trinks! Buscamos um Dev Ops Pleno para atuar no time de infraestrutura, com foco em automação, estabilidade e evolução contínua dos ambientes cloud. Você será responsável por manter e aprimorar pipelines de CI/CD, gerenciar a infraestrutura na AWS, acompanhar métricas de monitoramento, atuar na resolução de incidentes e liderar a comunicação técnica com times internos e parceiros. Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução: Garantir a confiabilidade e estabilidade dos ambientes produtivos e de homologação; Promover boas práticas de automação e infraestrutura como código (Ia C); Otimizar o ciclo de deploy e monitoramento contínuo; Conduzir comunicações técnicas com fornecedores e stakeholders; Inspirar confiança e ser referência técnica dentro do time. O que você precisa para o #match perfeito: Experiência sólida com AWS (ECS, EC2, RDS, ALB, WAF, Cloud Watch, S3); Conhecimento em Infra as Code (Terraform e/ou Cloud Formation); Experiência com pipelines CI/CD (Git Hub Actions ou similares); Conhecimento em monitoramento, logging e automação de alertas; Experiência com Docker e ambientes Linux e Windows Server; Conhecimento de redes, DNS, SSL, balanceamento e segurança em nuvem; Gostar de compartilhar conhecimentos e de trabalhar com equipe colaborativa. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Experiência com monitoramento avançado (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana); Conhecimento em scripts de automação (Python, Bash, Power Shell); Vivência com ECS Fargate e pipelines multiambiente; Experiência em otimização de custos em AWS; Certificações AWS ou Dev Ops. Saca só o que OFERECEMOS: 100% Home office; Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais); Auxílio home office; Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível; Plano de Saúde Sul América (custo zero para o colaborador); Plano Odonto Sul América (custo zero para o colaborador); Total Pass (plano academia); Incentivo ao Desenvolvimento: PDI, Capacitações, Feedbacks, Desconto com Faculdades e Cursos de Idiomas; Bônus por indicação de talentos; Day off de aniversário e tempo de casa. Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência. Na Trinks, valorizamos a melhor versão de você mesmo, com incentivos e autonomia para trabalhar, desenvolver e implementar ideias. E aí, se identificou? Então vem com a gente impulsionar e conectar os negócios de beleza LGPD na Trinks Você sabia que a Trinks adota uma rigorosa política para garantir o controle e a transparência no tratamento de dados das pessoas que têm interesse em fazer parte do nosso time? Todas as informações e dados obtidos ao longo do processo seletivo são tratados cuidadosamente, em conformidade com as normas da LGPD. Para mais informações, leia nossa política de dados no:

vagas.title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Global ta manager (contractor role) em palmas. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!) Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R& D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground. What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast. The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset. Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack. What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind. The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts. If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

vagas.title: Information technology manager
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Information technology manager em boa vista. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company's foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our Saa S ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, Java Script). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate Saa S contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based Saa S ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

vagas.title: Senior machine learning engineer
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Senior machine learning engineer em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us. What you'll do Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results. What we're looking for We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you. You'll be successful in this role if you have: Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow). Nice to have (not required) Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval. Why Join Us You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction. Equal Opportunity Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

vagas.title: English teacher
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando English teacher em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

vagas.title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Global ta manager (contractor role) em manaus. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!) Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R& D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground. What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast. The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset. Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack. What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind. The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts. If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

Company Description Gravity Interactive, Inc., established in California in 2003, is a leader in the online gaming industry, providing Gravity games to gamers across North America and beyond. It is the wholly owned subsidiary of Gravity Co., Ltd., a company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Gravity Co., Ltd. is globally renowned for developing the popular MMORPG title, Ragnarok Online, which has captivated players worldwide. With a mission to deliver exceptional gaming experiences, Gravity Interactive continues to serve a diverse and international audience. Role Description This is a month-to-month contract role for a Portuguese and English Bilingual LQA Specialist, for the project we estimate to last approximately 6 months. The role involves conducting linguistic quality assurance (LQA) tests for gaming content, identifying and rectifying translation errors, and ensuring linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance in Portuguese and English, ensuring consistency in the use of terminology across game mechanics, in-game items, storyline elements, and related materials. This position will assess text placement within the user interface and make linguistic adjustments where necessary to accommodate language expansion or contraction. The specialist will collaborate with the QA team and other departments when relevant, offering linguistic or localization support to facilitate overall project quality. Qualifications Be able to translate minimum of 2000 words/day and/or to review/edit 5000 words/day Fluency in Portuguese and English, with strong command of written and verbal communication in both languages Experience in Linguistic Quality Assurance (LQA) testing or localization, with the ability to identify and address linguistic, cultural, and contextual inaccuracies Knowledge of the gaming industry, familiarity with MMORPGs, and a passion for video games Strong detail-oriented mindset, problem-solving abilities, and capacity to meet deadlines in a hybrid work environment Proficiency in translation and localization tools; basic technical aptitude is a plus Bachelor's degree in Linguistics, Translation, Localization, or a related field preferred Prior experience working in a multicultural environment is advantageous

vagas.title: Information technology manager
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Information technology manager em rio branco. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company's foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our Saa S ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, Java Script). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate Saa S contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based Saa S ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

vagas.title: Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe)
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe) em rio branco. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\" Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS:* Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos. *PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES* Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA. Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil); Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina. Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

vagas.title: Motion designer
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Motion designer em rio branco. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

LEIA A DESCRIÇÃO! Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário: Wr B1wdp28 NOSSO JEITO DE SER E FAZER O time da Pay Conductor é feito por pessoas obcecadas por resolver problemas reais de pagamentos: gente que entende que cada décimo de ponto na taxa de aprovação representa milhões na ponta dos nossos clientes. Acreditamos que orquestração não é só tecnologia, é devolver às empresas o controle sobre o seu próprio dinheiro. Construímos uma plataforma AI-driven que conecta adquirentes, gateways e meios de pagamento em uma única camada inteligente, e estamos só começando. Se você quer fazer parte do time que está redefinindo a infraestrutura de pagamentos do Brasil, é aqui. E aí, quer construir o futuro dos pagamentos com a gente? SOBRE A VAGA O time de Marketing da Pay Conductor é responsável por traduzir uma plataforma técnica e robusta em uma marca desejada por empreendedores digitais, varejistas, e-commerces e líderes do mercado financeiro. A sua missão como Motion Designer será transformar conceitos complexos, como roteamento inteligente, taxa de aprovação, antifraude, recuperação de vendas e inteligência de pagamentos, em vídeos, animações e peças visuais que prendem atenção, explicam com clareza e fortalecem a percepção da marca. Buscamos uma pessoa criativa, detalhista e com repertório visual forte. Alguém que entenda que motion não é apenas "fazer elementos se mexerem", mas construir narrativa, ritmo e impacto visual. Você vai trabalhar de perto com Marketing, Conteúdo, Design e fundadores, criando assets para redes sociais, campanhas, materiais comerciais, eventos, lançamentos e apresentações. Mais do que executar briefings, queremos alguém que proponha caminhos visuais, teste formatos e ajude a construir uma marca forte, moderna e memorável. VOCÊ TERÁ ENTRE SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES: Criar vídeos e animações para os canais oficiais da Pay Conductor, como Linked In, Instagram, You Tube, site e novos canais conforme estratégia. Desenvolver motion graphics para posts, carrosséis animados, reels, vídeos curtos, campanhas e materiais institucionais. Transformar roteiros e conceitos técnicos em animações claras, bonitas e fáceis de entender. Animar ícones, gráficos, interfaces, fluxos de pagamento, dashboards, transações e elementos visuais da marca. Apoiar a produção de vídeos para campanhas de mídia paga, eventos, lançamentos e ações comerciais. Criar variações de peças animadas para testes de performance e diferentes formatos de distribuição. Editar vídeos curtos com ritmo, cortes, legendas, trilhas, transições e acabamento profissional. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com Design e Conteúdo para garantir coesão visual e narrativa da marca. Ajudar a evoluir a linguagem visual da Pay Conductor em movimento, respeitando identidade, paleta, tipografia e estilo da marca. Trazer referências visuais, tendências de motion, formatos de redes sociais e ideias para elevar a qualidade criativa dos conteúdos. VOCÊ AGREGARÁ SE POSSUIR: Portfólio com projetos de motion design, edição de vídeo, animação ou peças em movimento. Domínio de ferramentas como After Effects, Premiere, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Cap Cut ou similares. Boa noção de composição visual, ritmo, hierarquia, transição, storytelling e acabamento. Sensibilidade estética para criar peças modernas, limpas e com aparência premium. Capacidade de transformar temas técnicos em narrativas visuais simples e interessantes. Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas em uma rotina dinâmica de marketing. Repertório ativo de referências visuais, redes sociais, design, tecnologia e cultura digital. Vontade de aprender sobre fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce e inteligência artificial. VOCÊ SE DESTACARÁ SE TIVER: Experiência prévia com marcas B2 B, Saa S, fintech, tecnologia, meios de pagamento ou e-commerce.
